questions.stem: In the number 4,073,256, what is the value of the digit 7?
questions.explanation: In 4,073,256 the digits are: 4 (millions), 0 (hundred thousands), 7 (ten thousands), 3 (thousands), 2 (hundreds), 5 (tens), 6 (units). The 7 is in the ten thousands column, so its value is 70,000.

questions.stem: Which list shows these decimals in ascending order (smallest to largest)? 0.34, 0.3, 0.304, 0.043
questions.explanation: Writing with the same number of decimal places: 0.340, 0.300, 0.304, 0.043. Comparing: 0.043 < 0.300 < 0.304 < 0.340. So the order is 0.043, 0.3, 0.304, 0.34.

questions.stem: A number has the digit 5 in the hundredths column and the digit 8 in the tens column. Which of these could be the number?
questions.explanation: We need the digit 8 in the tens column (the tens place of the whole number part) and 5 in the hundredths column (second decimal place). In 83.05: 8 is in the tens column and 5 is in the hundredths column. This fits.

questions.stem: The number 6,400,000 is written in words as:

options.text: Six million and four hundred thousand

questions.explanation: 6,400,000 = 6,000,000 + 400,000, which is six million and four hundred thousand.

questions.stem: What is the difference in value between the digit 3 in 2.31 and the digit 3 in 4.036?
questions.explanation: In 2.31, the 3 is in the tenths column, so its value is 0.3. In 4.036, the 3 is in the hundredths column, so its value is 0.03. The difference is 0.3 - 0.03 = 0.27.
